ambient_events: Something crashes several floors above. Then laughter.
A wall-mounted screen plays a looping corporate training video on conflict resolution.
description: Dense, vertical, and loud. Pre-Handoff apartment complexes have been stacked with improvised floors. The streets below are narrow tunnels of laundry lines and extension cords.

flags.intro_lore: Pre-Handoff apartment towers stacked with improvised floors until they groan — loud, dense, vertical, and home to most of the basin that isn't dead yet. The Sprawl polices itself in ways you won't understand until you've broken one of its rules. Rent is cheap; the neighbors are the price.

name: The Sprawl
